summary: The notes compare a donor’s papers and a promised charitable payment.
notes: The questions concern what commitment, consideration, or reliance the institution can identify, and whether a promised use of money supplies a genuine exchange. These examples prevent treating every charitable aspiration as automatically enforceable. The precise special rule in § 90(2) and its acceptance by a court are separate inquiries.
